title: Prime London Mortgages
h1: Prime London Mortgages (search-result title for the page in [a] and [b]; not confirmed as the on-page H1)
metaDescription: Not revealed by any of the three searches.
summary: The page positions prime London mortgages as residential loans for high-value property in London's prime and super-prime markets, aimed at HNW/UHNW buyers, business owners with dividend-led income, international families, entrepreneurs, investors and globally mobile executives, including buyers who want interest-only terms to preserve liquidity. It stresses that such deals involve complex property characteristics (lease terms, building type, valuation nuance) and sophisticated borrower profiles. Silver Oak Capital's role is described in three pillars: lender selection for prime cases across specialist high-value lenders and private banks, preparing a lender-ready narrative/case summary, and negotiation (pricing and fees) plus project management with valuers and solicitors. The page has an FAQ section (one visible question: whether these mortgages take longer than standard ones), but its answers, rates, fees, LTVs and calls to action were not visible in snippets. Related site pages seen: /prime-residential-mortgages/ (indicative example: GBP 7m, 1.25% + Libor, 65% LTV, 5 years renewable, interest only, 20% AUM pledge, 0.50% lender fee), case studies (Notting Hill GBP 6.35m IO refinance at 60% LTV via private bank; Mayfair GBP 7.5m IO at 75% LTV on a GBP 10m home; GBP 1.46m PCL refinance) and a bridging-for-PCL-purchases page not in the seed.
